hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: EXECUTION_PARAMETER
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: For multiple parameters, use '|' to separate the different parameters Ex: -c|-h|--print_filepath -s --statistics_weekly_option 2512W1|-s --statistics_weekly_option_by_date 250904@w --statistics_analysis_method 1|-l

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash -e #set -eux #set -eu
cleanup() { # stop 後如果容器是 --rm 建立的 → 容器就會被自動刪除 docker stop "${CONTAINER_NAME}" echo "The container was deleted: ${CONTAINER_NAME}" } trap cleanup EXIT
LOCAL=Asia/Taipei DOCKER_COMMAND="-e TZ=${LOCAL} --rm -dit -v ${HOST_SRC_PATH}:/app --name ${CONTAINER_NAME}" if [ "${NEED_DATA}" = "true" ] then DOCKER_COMMAND="${DOCKER_COMMAND} -e DATA_PATH=${CONTAINER_DATA_PATH} -v ${HOST_DATA_PATH}:${CONTAINER_DATA_PATH}" fi
docker container rm -f ${CONTAINER_NAME} 2> /dev/null || true docker container run ${DOCKER_COMMAND} ${PYTHON_IMAGE_NAME} bash echo "******************************************************************" now=$(TZ=$LOCAL date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") echo "${now}: Stock Fluctuation Statistics Execution" IFS='|' read -r -a param_array <<< "${EXECUTION_PARAMETER}" tags="" for param in "${param_array[@]}" do echo "@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@" echo "Execute the '${param}' parameter" echo "@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@" docker container exec -i "${CONTAINER_NAME}" bash -c "python ./miscellaneous/stock_fluctuation_statistics.py ${param}" echo "" done echo "******************************************************************"
